xmldoc.short_description: Enum types of a schema, or the values of one enum type.

param_input_item.param_description: a protobuf.Schema object returned by protobuf.load.
the enum type: a full name or a unique trailing part such as 'Color'.

param_output_item.param_description: without a type: the full names of the enum types of the schema.
with a type: a table with the variables Name and Number, the values of that enum type.

description.p: protobuf.enums lists the enum types of a schema, or the names and numbers of one enum type. The names are the ones accepted when encoding enum fields and returned by the 'EnumsAsText' option of protobuf.decode.

example_item.example_item_description: Values of an enum type, and enum fields by name
